svg.title: How Holly invests in engineers
svg.desc: An M5 Pro MacBook Pro with an 18-core CPU, 20-core GPU, and 48 GB of memory; Claude Max, Codex with ChatGPT Pro, and Ollama Pro for every engineer; an annual hackathon and engineering onsite in Holly's New York City or San Francisco office; a $3,000 annual learning budget; and one open-source day each month.
svg.text: Tools, time, and budget to do your best work.

g.text: Powerful hardware, ready on day one.
Pick the best model for the job. Usage is on us.
